arguments.command:
timeout 120 git push -q origin chore/release-2.3.0 2>&1 | tail -1; timeout 60 gh pr view 45 --json body --jq .body > /tmp/body.md; python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('/tmp/body.md').read()
a="See [Working-tree continuity](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/threads.md#working-tree-continuity).\n"
assert a in s
add = a + """- **A workflow log that shows what pi does** (#46, added in #48, #49, and #50). The log shows one line for each step while pi works: `💬` for the text of the model, `🔧` when a tool call starts, and `↳ ✓` or `↳ ✗ failed` when it ends. Click a `↳` line to see the arguments of the call and the last 30 lines of its output. Each reply gets a `✅ Replied` line with the comment and totals: model responses, tool calls, time, and tokens. The setup is in a collapsed `Setup` group. The thread, with the git commands that read it, is now at the start of the log. Pushes and working-tree snapshots are debug messages: to see them, enable step debug logging. See [The workflow log](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/how-it-works.md#the-workflow-log).

### Fixed
- **A fetch by pi no longer breaks the run** (#46, fixed in #47). If pi fetched into `refs/pi/*`, for example with `git fetch origin '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*'`, it moved the ref that the run was writing to. The session then failed without a reply, a reaction, or a failed step. A run now keeps its refs on `refs/pi-action/*` on the runner, and pushes them to `refs/pi/*` on the remote. See [Protection against conflicts](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/threads.md#protection-against-conflicts).
- **A failed session is reported** (#46, fixed in #47). If the storage of the thread fails, pi-action posts a `❌ pi Error` comment with the cause, adds 😕 to the request, and fails the step.
- **No false warning from `Save pi thread state`** (#46, fixed in #47). If the remote already has the local commits, the step writes `already saved` to the log, not a warning.
"""
s=s.replace(a,add)
s=s.replace("It adds a new feature and breaks nothing","It adds new features and breaks nothing")
open('/tmp/body.md','w').write(s)
EOF
timeout 60 gh pr edit 45 --body-file /tmp/body.md 2>&1 | tail -1
